There is an exploding need for professionals in every field who can analyze and manage data to make effective business decisions. The Lubin MBA in Business Analytics gives students the technical edge for a satisfying analytical career in data analytics, financial engineering, risk management, market research, or management consulting.

The curriculum provides comprehensive analytics skills: analysis and modeling techniques that cover the whole spectrum of descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics—ad hoc reports, data visualization to regression, data mining, and optimization. Students will learn how to solve real-world business problems with cutting-edge software tools like R, SQL, Excel, and Tableau.
